senses.gloss: ओ॑ह m. (fr. √ वह्, or आ-√ वह्; fr. √ 2. ऊह्, BRD.), a vehicle, means, RV. i, 180, 5
ओ॑ह mfn. bringing near, causing to approach, RV. iv, 10, 1
worthy to be approached, excellent, RV. i, 61, 1 [Sāy.]
ओह—ब्रह्मन् m. (a priest) possessing or conveying Brahman or sacred knowledge (उह्यमानम् ब्रह्म … येषां ते, Sāy.), RV. x, 71, 8.
ओ॑हस् n. a vehicle, means (fig. said of a Stotra, Sāy.), RV. vi, 67, 9.
ओहल m. N. of a man.
